segments.text:
V. 20.
The ſon of man—The Expreſſion is borrowed from Dan. vii. 13. and is the Appellation which CHRIST commonly gives himſelf: Which he ſeems to do out of Humility, as having ſome relation to his mean Appearance in this World. Hath not where to lay his head—Therefore do not follow me, from any View of temporal Advantage.
